verdicts.reason: I couldn't see any difference between the two candidates, so it's a tie. Both have the same problems. The 'THE SOLSTICE TASTING TEAM' attribution is set bolder and about as big as the quote, so the fine print competes with the message. The quote is very small italic and hard to read at 320x50. The quote mark crowds the top-left corner. The SOLSTICE logo is shrunk to a near-invisible speck. The product can is a tiny sliver jammed against the right edge, and the left side is cramped while the space around the can is left empty.
